purpose.summary: This is the main menu/navigation program (ORCGM01N) for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles screen initialization, screen transitions (PUTG/CLICKED events), user input, and dispatches to subsystems such as master maintenance, job management, and print deletion. It acts as the top-level menu controller for a Japanese medical billing/receipt application.

verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in comments. The program is clearly production-grade, part of the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system ORCA. The MCP middleware pattern (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW, MCP-PUTTYPE) is characteristic of the ORCA/Panda system's screen management framework, not CICS, but the program_type is classified as online-cics as the closest analogue for an event-driven screen program.
